newRecordDraft.summaryZh: 该团队开发基于自剪接 I 组内含子核酶的治疗性转剪接核酶，以移除或替换底物 RNA 片段，并通过定向进化改善核酶序列。页面将临床应用表述为未来期望。

evidence.quote: Professor Ulrich Muller Principle Investigator Uli Müller is interested in the evolution of catalytic RNAs (ribozymes).
The main focus is the question ' How did Life Start? '
combining RNA biochemistry (catalytic RNAs and their selection, evolution, characterization)
We are also interested in developing therapeutic ribozymes based on self-splicing group I intron ribozymes.
we have developed directed evolution strategies
We re-design them into trans-splicing ribozymes that can remove and/or replace RNA fragments on substrate RNAs, and thereby re-program them for treatments of diseases.
We hope that the near future will see ribozyme-based RNA splicing as a useful approach for clinical applications.
